crossRefs.note: At that time it will be said to this people and to Jerusalem, “A hot wind from the bare heights in the wilderness…
a full wind from these will come for me. Now I will also utter judgments against them.”
Yahweh says: “Behold, I will raise up against Babylon, and against those who dwell in Lebkamai, a destroying wind.
Then I lifted up my eyes and saw, and behold, there were two women, and the wind was in their wings. Now they had wings…
It also will be carried to Assyria for a present to a great king. Ephraim will receive shame, and Israel will be…
For they shall be ashamed of the oaks which you have desired, and you shall be confounded for the gardens that you have…
“Those who trust in engraved images, who tell molten images, ‘You are our gods,’ will be turned back. They will be…
As the thief is ashamed when he is found, so the house of Israel is ashamed: they, their kings, their princes, their…
who tell wood, ‘You are my father,’ and a stone, ‘You have given birth to me,’ for they have turned their back to me…
Why do you go about so much to change your ways? You will be ashamed of Egypt also, as you were ashamed of Assyria.
You will also leave that place with your hands on your head; for Yahweh has rejected those in whom you trust, and you…
But the shameful thing has devoured the labor of our fathers from our youth, their flocks and their herds, their sons…
Let us lie down in our shame, and let our confusion cover us; for we have sinned against Yahweh our God, we and our…
Yahweh, the hope of Israel, all who forsake you will be disappointed. Those who depart from me will be written in the…

translations.web: The wind has wrapped her up in its wings; and they shall be disappointed because of their sacrifices.
translations.bsb: The whirlwind has wrapped them in its wings, and their sacrifices will bring them shame.
translations.kjv: The wind hath bound her up in her wings, and they shall be ashamed because of their sacrifices.
translations.asv: The wind hath wrapped her up in its wings; and they shall be put to shame because of their sacrifices.
